description: The chart illustrates the difference in average Word Error Rate (WER) from the Whisper large model across various applied optimizations for two different models. The vertical axis contains the categories, labeled "Optimisations applied," listing the categories from top to bottom as Normalised, Add Spacing, Remove Spacing, Americanisms, and Dates. The horizontal value axis is labeled "Difference in Average WER from Whisper large" and features a linear scale starting from 0.000, with visible tick marks at intervals of 0.001, though the 0.003 tick label is obscured by a grey rectangle. The chart uses horizontal grouped bars, with each category containing two adjacent bars representing different models as indicated by the legend: the top orange bar represents the "NESAC ft model" and the bottom green bar represents the "SESHA ft model." Every bar is visually emphasized with an annotation of its exact numerical value at its right end. For the "Normalised" category, the orange bar is 0.00334 and the green bar is 0.00323. In "Add Spacing," the orange bar is 0.00319 and the green bar is the longest in the chart at 0.00344. For "Remove Spacing," the values are 0.00311 (orange) and 0.00306 (green). Under "Americanisms," the orange bar reads 0.00299 and the green bar is 0.00302. Finally, the "Dates" category contains the shortest bars, with the orange bar at 0.00257 and the green bar being the shortest overall at 0.00228. The categories are arranged in a roughly descending order based on their overall values from top to bottom.
